initial.title: Record discoveries from inspected evidence without confusing verification with discovery
initial.body: Empty discovery placeholders previously caused stalled_search signals; later records do not erase earlier empty events. Inspect each search result group before recording discoveries, preserving search_many input order. If snippets lack names, distinguish that from an empty search: inspect the selected documents and attribute newly identified entities to their originating query before closing its discovery record. Keep a local ledger of entities and originating queries so names learned from fetched documents are not silently omitted from discovery bookkeeping. Record [] honestly for searches that only verify fields of already known entities; useful nationality or affiliation verification need not discover new people. Never invent discoveries or repeat known names merely to suppress a stall signal.

current.title: Resolve semantic audit findings without narrowing the requested field
current.body: A passing schema, quote-membership check, or constraint log does not establish semantic completeness. When an audit identifies additional historical affiliations or other omitted values, resolve the finding against the requested field definition and dated evidence. Do not dismiss concurrent or honorary affiliations solely because a preferred announcement omits them: 'affiliation at award' and 'affiliation listed by the awarding body' are different scopes. Verify whether the additional positions applied at the relevant date, then include supported values or document an evidence-based exclusion. An inconclusive follow-up search does not resolve the finding. Only mark the semantic constraint satisfied after this reconciliation.

current.title: Recover failed primary-source pages through official alternate formats
current.body: When a primary-source page fails to download, inspect the recorded failure and search for another official publication of the same material, including a downloadable PDF. Select an actual URL from search results, fetch it, and retain its text and URL together. Reuse successful downloads from the original batch. Group extraction by document when it covers several related entities, using an explicit nested schema. Check field coverage separately: a document may support names, dates, affiliations and award motivations without explicitly stating nationality or citizenship. Do not infer citizenship from birthplace or institutional location. Validate extracted quotations against the exact downloaded text before accepting records; PDF column layout and whitespace can affect verbatim quotations.
current.trigger: Official Nobel press release PDFs were directly downloadable and provided grouped evidence for laureates, citizenship, affiliations, and motivations; a failed 2015 academy page was replaced by a PDF discovered through search. Use quote-membership checks after schema-validated extraction.
